Some regular sessions occasionally receive a variant with a delayed *"I'll fix it next time"* dismiss button. > * **Consent Requirement:** Only triggers after OneTrust (`cbsoptanon`) allows targeting/advertising cookies (`cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`). > > ### Proxied Admiral Script URLs Observed > * `https://silkyslumber.com/static/kmxtcpfvq/q1zxupa.js` > * `https://topicspin.com/static/k6vi91qgp/siqqoqasp4mu874ckh6569s5n2uum.js` > > ### Inline Bootstrap & Obfuscation Details > * Admiral's inline loader is wrapped in `loadAdmiralScript()` and invoked asynchronously inside `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` $\rightarrow$ `cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`. > * Because `loadAdmiralScript()` runs asynchronously after `document.currentScript` is `null`, inline scriptlets hooking `document.createElement` do not catch it. > * Evades generic Admiral signatures by aliasing `decodeURI` (`D(D(Y))`) and double-encoding `'admiral'` (`%25%36%31%64m%25%36%39%25%37%32%2561%6C`). > * Static Admiral Property ID in inline script: `QS01RDlDQzI1QTgyQ0FFMzUwNTQ5RkMwQUMtMg` > > ### Suggested / Verified Fix > Aborting synchronously when `loadAdmiralScript` is registered with `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` blocks Admiral before any proxied scripts are fetched: > ```adblock > cbsnews.com#%#//scriptlet('abort-current-inline-script', 'cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady', 'loadAdmiralScript') > ``` ``` Username: @SpoiledSneeze ``` ### Screenshots
